title: Deterministic Adam-Inspired Methods with Accelerated Convergence Rate
abstract: arXiv:2604.08742v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Adam is widely used, but its convergence theory remains incomplete even in the deterministic full-batch setting because momentum and adaptive preconditioning are tightly coupled. For smooth convex objectives, we split the momentum variable through variable-and-operator splitting, which reveals the acceleration mechanism. We then combine a Hessian-driven correction with Adam-style feedback based on the gradient magnitude. The resulting Adam-HNAG (Hessian-driven Nesterov accelerated gradient with Adam-style adaptive preconditioning) flow admits a nonnegative energy that decays exponentially. Its discretization yields two methods, Adam-HNAG and the synchronous variant Adam-HNAG-s. Under the stated trajectory-bound and consistency conditions, both methods satisfy a discrete Lyapunov contraction. translated_title: 确定性Adam启发方法及其加速收敛率
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.08742v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：Adam被广泛使用，但其收敛理论即使在确定性的全批次设置中仍不完整，因为动量和自适应预处理紧密耦合。对于光滑凸目标，我们通过变量和算子分裂来拆分动量变量，这揭示了加速机制。然后，我们结合基于梯度幅度的Adam风格反馈的Hessian驱动校正。所得到的Adam-HNAG（具有Adam风格自适应预处理的Hessian驱动Nesterov加速梯度）流具有非负能量，且能量指数衰减。其离散化产生了两种方法，Adam-HNAG和同步变体Adam-HNAG-s。在所述轨迹边界和一致性条件下，两种方法都满足离散Lyapunov收缩。如果接受精确的自适应步骤，这种收缩给出了$O(k^{-2})$目标值界。数值实验说明了这些结果。
tldr: 本文提出Adam-HNAG方法，通过Hessian驱动校正和Adam风格反馈，在确定性凸优化中实现了指数能量衰减和$O(k^{-2})$的加速收敛率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Adam-HNAG methods, achieving exponential energy decay and an $O(k^{-2})$ accelerated convergence rate in deterministic convex optimization via Hessian-driven correction and Adam-style feedback.
